title: fd_tracktopol
description: `fd_tracktopol` maps a `sigmund~` “tracks” output list to a triangle represented as a polygon of three points, with an index prepended to the output list. It is intended for converting tracked spectral data into polygon coordinates; the help patch demonstrates using three instances via `clone fd_tracktopol 3 10 20`, with arguments including an instance number and y-offset.
